description: Publishes the stable conversation id (SessionStart/End) and confirms which Bridge entries reached the model (UserPromptSubmit/Stop, RFC-027)

hooks.command: command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-map.ts" start
command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/session-map.ts" end
command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/delivery.ts" prompt
command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; exec bun "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/delivery.ts" stop
